observations: Under corrected implementation (sorted roles + direct 499500-pair estimator), the canonical per-iteration recipe reproduces C2 FALSE: observed 0.333 < null 0.586 (M3, M4). This confirms the parent's FALSIFIED conclusion is genuine, not an implementation artifact

Under corrected implementation, the per-task weighted recipe produces C2 TRUE: observed 0.333 > null 0.205 (M7, M8). The reversal PERSISTS under corrected code, meaning it is NOT an artifact of the old unsorted-set/estimator-mismatch bugs
The recipe divergence is large: canonical null mean 0.586 vs per-task weighted null mean 0.205 (M9: 0.3805 absolute divergence). Recipe choice flips the C2 direction entirely

NC2 fails: per-task weighted null mean (0.2100) deviates from parent's stored ~0.28 by 0.0700, exceeding the 0.05 threshold (M11). The parent's stored per-task weighted value was not precisely reproducible under corrected implementation
F3 triggers: same deviation (0.0700 > 0.05). The parent's stored per-task weighted null mean was affected by the implementation bugs, but the DIRECTION (null < observed) is preserved
The canonical recipe's null mean also deviates from parent (0.5697 vs 0.5273, deviation 0.0424), but C2 direction is unchanged (both FALSE). The estimator change affects both recipes systematically
DEF-FULL-MAP and DEF-FORM-ONLY orderings match parent exactly: cart>product_listing for both. ISOLATED-A-LINK gives cart>detail, differing from the other two definitions on detail vs product_listing
Per-seed SD for canonical recipe is 0.0123 (across seeds), and for per-task weighted is 0.0046. Both recipes are highly reproducible across seeds despite the null mean deviation from parent
validity_notes: Truncated-first-20 locatable sample only (7 tasks, 1 Magento site, cart n=1). Results do not generalize to full-DOM or cross-site data

3 of 5 planned definitions independently verified. Pairwise agreement is C(3,2)=3 pairs, not C(5,2)=10. The observed agreement metric (0.333) is not directly comparable to parent's 0.3 (from 5 definitions), but the null distribution comparison is valid

The parent's per-task weighted null mean (~0.28) was computed with the OLD buggy implementation (unsorted set + sampled 10000-pair estimator). The corrected implementation uses sorted roles + direct 499500-pair estimator, which produces a systematically lower null mean (0.205). The 0.05 threshold was designed to accommodate estimator differences but the actual deviation (0.07) exceeds it, indicating the old bugs had a larger effect on the per-task weighted recipe than anticipated

The canonical recipe's null mean also deviates from parent (0.5697 vs 0.5273, deviation 0.0424), but the C2 direction is unchanged. This systematic shift is consistent with the estimator change (sampled 10000 vs direct 499500 pairs) affecting both recipes
